summary: Early backtest on one failure case (Silicon Valley Bank) and one control (Fifth Third Bancorp). The legal-risk dimension registered elevated activity in the failure case. Separation between failure and control is not yet established, and news-volume scoring did not contribute in this run. These results are directional evidence that the approach detects legal-risk signals; they are not a statistical validation of lead time.

Silicon Valley Bank.label: failed
Silicon Valley Bank.note: Composite rose to 3.1/10 on the failure date; earlier elevation to 0.4 occurred ~7 weeks prior on legal signal.

Fifth Third Bancorp.label: control
Fifth Third Bancorp.note: Control peaked at 2.6/10; did not fail. Control scoring in range of the failure case indicates the current threshold does not yet separate the two.

limitations: Single failure case and single control — no statistical power.
News-volume dimension produced zero across all observations; not yet contributing.
Threshold does not yet separate the failure case from the healthy control.
Legal-risk signal is the only active dimension in this run.
